reason: A is the more substantive and decisively testable proposal because it introduces a single compositional intervention and compares doped and baseline alloys under identical thermal histories, whereas B largely repeats the already demonstrated melt-spinning result and does not isolate annealing with an unannealed melt-spun control. A remains weakly grounded—its 2 at.% B level, rate boundaries, and “network former” mechanism require justification—but these are testable uncertainties rather than B’s unsupported use of ~960 K as a sub-Tg reheating boundary.
